name: Shelly 1PM Gen4 UL-Certified
summary: In-wall single-channel relay with power metering; Wi-Fi, Matter, Zigbee and Bluetooth.

extra.protocol_switch: Matter default; 5 presses to switch to Zigbee profile
extra.ul_conflict: KB shows EU model S4SW-001P16EU rated 16A/240V; family says UL-Certified (US UL variant rating may differ, often 15A)

gotchas: Rating ambiguity: KB (EU model) says 16A, blurb says 15A — size for 15A on US circuits
Needs a neutral at the box
Matter vs Zigbee is a either/or profile (Matter default; Zigbee via 5-press switch)
Output is the line-powered relay (not dry contact) — for potential-free switching see Shelly Plus 1 UL-Certified
Larger 37x42 body than the Mini line — tight boxes may need the 1PM Mini Gen4
best_for: metered on/off of a 15A lighting/appliance circuit behind a US wall switch with Matter or Zigbee
